# AMGF - Libertate Financiara

> AMGF este un ecosistem DeFi transparent construit pe reteaua Base (Ethereum L2), centrat pe tokenul $AMGF (ERC-20, contract 0x64bfE8A8C23b896ab810e2a051cC6E5F0C2ac765). Include un portofel non-custodial multi-chain, AMGF Code App, platforma educationala AMGF Learn si botul de comunitate AMGF Liberty pe Telegram.

## Pagini principale

- [Pagina principala](https://amgf-finance.com/): prezentarea proiectului, tokenomics, roadmap, transparenta lichiditatii
- [Cartea Alba](https://amgf-finance.com/whitepaper.html): whitepaper complet v1.0 - misiune, tokenomics, trezoreria ecosistemului, aspecte tehnice
- [Comunitate](https://amgf-finance.com/community.html): pagina comunitatii AMGF
- [Statistici Live](https://amgf-finance.com/stats.html): dashboard live cu pret, market cap si fonduri blocate

## Aplicatii din ecosistem

- [AMGF Wallet N.C.](https://wallet.amgf-finance.com): portofel non-custodial multi-chain
- [AMGF Code App](https://code.amgf-finance.com): platforma de dezvoltare
- [AMGF Learn](https://learn.amgf-finance.com): platforma educationala gratuita
- [AMGF Liberty Bot](https://t.me/amgf_liberty_bot): botul de comunitate pe Telegram

## Date cheie

- Retea: Base (Coinbase Ethereum L2)
- Total supply: 1,000,000,000 $AMGF
- Alocare: 25% echipa & fondator (blocat pe GemPad pana pe 9 iunie 2027), 20% trezorerie ecosistem (vesting pe GemPad pana pe 31 august 2027), 15% rezerva fondator (blocat pe GemPad pana pe 3 iulie 2028), 40% lichiditate & comunitate (in circulatie)
- 61% din LP-ul Uniswap V2 blocat pe GemPad pana pe 5 iunie 2027
- Contract imuabil: owner renuntat (0x000...000), minimal proxy EIP-1167 fara functie de upgrade
- Contact: contact@amgf-finance.com | Telegram: @amgf_liberty_bot
